evidence_timeline.summary: Here we report the ATLAS discovery of the transient ATLAS26irw (AT2026vbh) in galaxy MCG -02-04-031 at magnitude m_o = 18.02 +/- 0.08. At a distance of 72 Mpc, the transient was discovered on MJD = 61238.60 (2026-07-17.60) with an absolute magnitude of M = -16.35 +/- 0.08. The last non-detection through forced photometry was on MJD = 61228.39. Forced photometry indicates that the transient is rising. Spectroscopic classification is encouraged.
